mapper.select: SELECT cm.*, m.nickname as sender_nickname FROM chat_messages cm JOIN members m ON cm.sender_id = m.member_id WHERE cm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT cm.*, m.nickname as sender_nickname FROM chat_messages cm JOIN members m ON cm.sender_id = m.member_id WHERE cm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND is_deleted = 'N' AND created_at > NVL(#{lastReadAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
SELECT cm.*, m.nickname as sender_nickname FROM chat_messages cm JOIN members m ON cm.sender_id = m.member_id WHERE cm.message_id = #{messageId}
